Zeidy felt like he was dreaming. After two years of trying to sell his apartment, the selling offer was made minutes after davening at the Ohel!

The next day, Zeidy went to a bris and stood near a friend. “So, what’s going on with your apartment?” the friend asked.

“I just sold it!” Zeidy said happily. “Now I’m looking for one to buy near the shul.”

The friend thought for a moment. “You know what? I’m trying to sell an apartment in that very area! It’s much bigger than your old one and is worth a lot more, but I’ll sell it to you for the same price that you sold your apartment for.”

A person next to them couldn’t believe what he was hearing. “You’re selling such a big apartment for so cheap?!”

Turning to Zeidy, he exclaimed, “Buy it! For this price, it’s almost free!”

But Zeidy still wasn’t sure. The yearly taxes and monthly building fees were still much more expensive than he thought he could afford. Seeing Zeidy’s hesitation, his friend said, “Don’t worry about it. I’ll pay the taxes and fees for the first year until you can manage it on your own.”

The very next day, Zeidy went to sign the documents. I asked the Rebbe for help only a few days ago, he realized with wonder. And now, not only did I sell my apartment, but I already have a new one!

As the Rebbe’s chossid, Zeidy had turned to the Rebbe when he was facing a challenge. And the Rebbe’s brachos had come true—right away!

After a visit to the Ohel, Zeidy didn’t have to wait much longer…

Zeidy lived in Jardins, a neighborhood in S. Paulo, Brazil, for many years. Eventually, he became the rav of a shul in a different area that was a very far walk away.

Zeidy needed to buy an apartment closer to the shul, but first, he had to sell the apartment he was living in.

For two whole years, Zeidy tried selling the apartment, but no one was interested in buying it.

Then, soon before Chof Menachem Av, Zeidy traveled to New York like he always does to join the Yarchei Kallah at Gan Yisroel

Parksville. It’s a time when rabbanim from all over the world spend a Shabbos together, learning Torah and getting chizzuk for the entire year.

After Shabbos, Zeidy went to daven at the Ohel and told the Rebbe about his challenge with the apartment. Please give me a bracha to sell my apartment and buy a new one closer to the shul, he davened.

Right after leaving the Ohel, Zeidy sat down to drink a coffee. A few minutes later, he got a WhatsApp message from his real estate agent. I just got an excellent offer for your apartment. The buyer wants to sign right away.

The agent sent Zeidy a copy of the offer, and just a few days later, the apartment was sold!
